image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a wombat peering out from the entrance of a burrow. The animal's head and upper torso are visible, framed by rough, textured rock or earth forming the tunnel opening. The wombat has coarse, brownish-grey fur, a broad blunt snout with a large dark nose, and small eyes. Its ears are rounded and upright. The lighting is natural, casting shadows inside the burrow. There is some straw or dry grass on the ground near the wombat's chest. A faint red watermark/text is visible in the bottom right corner.
